appDescription: Pleorder prepares food delivery and pickup orders using public restaurant data. Orders and payments are simulated and require explicit confirmation.

function.name: FIND_FOOD
function.description: Recommend restaurants near the saved delivery place, current position or route; browse menus with prices; continue numbered choices; recall last or usual completed orders. Choosing never makes a payment. More/choose refer to the previous app conversation.

query.description: Food, restaurant or menu name, without filler words.

selection.description: Number from the previously returned list, starting at 1.

answer.description: Exact spoken choice or refusal. Preserve negation.

storeId.description: Exact restaurant ID returned by the app; never invent.

timing.description: Schedule around arrival only when requested.

excludeRecent.description: True when user wants something different from the last meal.

function.name: MANAGE_FOOD_ORDER
function.description: Modify the unapproved draft, identify one of several orders, query order number/status, cancel, resume a HELD reservation keeping its original delivery address, or confirm pickup collection. Never approve payment. If user changes destination use delivery location search instead.

target.description: Exact order ID or restaurant name for a placed order. Ask which one if ambiguous.

menu.description: Menu name whose quantity should change.

add.description: Exact menu name to add from the same store.

note.description: Kitchen/delivery requests exactly as spoken, not a paid option.

option.description: Exact registered menu option name to change; not a free-form paid add-on.

function.name: PREPARE_FOOD_ORDER
function.description: Prepare a simulated delivery or pickup draft with meal, quantity, destination, total and selected payment method. Submission requires a separate explicit confirmation.

query.description: Meal or restaurant requested by the user.

fulfillment.description: delivery sends food to the selected delivery location; pickup collects it at the selected restaurant. No real order is sent.

timing.description: soon prepares now; arrival schedules simulated delivery around the driver's home arrival.

items.description: Multiple menu items with Korean quantities, e.g. ["비빔밥 두 개", "불고기 한 개"]. Only one restaurant per draft.

reorder.description: Only when user requests a previous completed order.

note.description: Free kitchen request, not a paid option.

function.name: CONFIRM_FOOD_ORDER
function.description: Approve or decline the current simulated draft after the user reviews its total and payment method. Changing a payment method creates a new draft requiring fresh confirmation.

draftId.description: Optional exact draft ID returned by the app. Omit to use the most recent unexpired order quote read back by the app.

confirmation.description: True for explicit approval of the current order and payment details; false for rejection.

paymentMethod.description: Registered card name (현대카드 M, 신한카드 Mr.Life, 삼성카드 taptap O). Changing a card only re-quotes and needs a separate approval.

utterance.description: The exact user approval/refusal utterance, preserving ALL negation. Never convert a choice or repeated meal request into consent.

function.name: GET_FOOD_ORDER_STATUS
function.description: Get the current simulated food delivery or pickup status and remaining preparation or delivery information.

target.description: Optional order ID or restaurant name when several orders exist.

function.name: SEARCH_DELIVERY_DESTINATION
function.description: Search for a delivery destination in Pleorder. Returns numbered real places for the user to choose. Does not change vehicle navigation or save a destination until confirmed. Use when the user asks to set or change the food delivery address, hotel or destination.

query.description: Place name or street address spoken by the user. Exclude building units and room numbers; use SET_DELIVERY_ADDRESS_DETAIL for them.

function.name: CONFIRM_DELIVERY_DESTINATION
function.description: Confirm or reject a previously searched Pleorder delivery destination. Call only after the user selects a numbered result or explicitly confirms the single result. Never invent coordinates.

selection.description: The numbered result chosen by the user, starting at 1. May be omitted if there is only one result.

confirmation.description: True when the user chooses or confirms a result. False when the user rejects or cancels the location selection.

function.name: SET_DELIVERY_ADDRESS_DETAIL
function.description: Save or correct the building unit, room number, floor or lobby for the Pleorder delivery destination. Read the saved detail back. If destination selection is pending, attach it to the pending selection. Do not change vehicle navigation.

detail.description: Only the address detail spoken by the user. Preserve all building and room digits exactly. Maximum 80 characters. Use an empty string only when the user explicitly asks to clear the address detail.
